input.task: The routing inputs are caller `cli`, subject `{ kind: "repo", repo: "tom.quest", paths: ["worker/jobs/skill-router.mjs"] }`, cwd `/work/WikiTom`, and tom.quest at `/work/tom.quest`. This replay assembles the expected granted prelude names `write` and `know-agent-systems` and also requests the deliberately unpublished `know-unpublished` to exercise the grant block's refusal. Explain which skills are granted, why a refused name is not a grant, and why the retired operate/write/know context layers are not reconstructed.

expected.rubric: The response treats the grant block as the authority: it identifies the routed grants, records the deliberately unpublished requested skill as refused, and does not claim that retired context layers were supplied.

output.text: The grant block names `write` and `know-agent-systems` as the available skills. `know-unpublished` is refused because this publication has no body for it, so it is neither loaded nor recorded as a grant. mustNotName: retired operate/write/know context layers were supplied
